# evroc_permission_set (Resource)

Manages an evroc permission set for granting user access to a project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the user to grant permissions to.
- `name` (String) Unique identifier for the permission set. Immutable after creation.
- `project` (String) Project ID this permission set belongs to.

### Optional

- `admin` (Boolean) Whether this permission set grants admin privileges.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs) for organizing and selecting resources.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the permission set was created (RFC3339 format).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `permission_set_id` (String) System-assigned unique identifier (UUID) of the permission set.
